Tatiana Quijano

Scheduling Assistant

Tatiana Quijano is the firm’s Scheduling Assistant and Happiness Coordinator, ensuring smooth client intake, appointment scheduling, and attorney calendar management while generating reports that keep everything running efficiently. With over a decade of experience in Customer Service, Administrative Assistance, and Legal Assistance, she brings exceptional organization and a client-focused approach to her role.

Tatiana’s positive attitude and tireless energy make her an invaluable asset to the firm, as she is committed to providing outstanding service to both clients and colleagues. Driven by her family’s support and inspiration, she approaches each day with dedication and enthusiasm.

Marie is admitted to the following jurisdictions:

  • Colorado, 1999
  • U.S. District Court, District of Colorado, 2008
  • U.S. Bankruptcy Court, 2008
  • U.S. Court of Appeals, 10th Circuit, 2008
  • U.S. Supreme Court, 2009
